text:
anna: Quick ping — drafting copy for a model pin confirmation modal. Can folks skim? Trying to be concise and a11y-friendly.

anna: Draft (first pass):
Header: Pin model to route
Body: Pinning keeps this route on the selected model version instead of receiving automatic model updates. This improves output stability but you may miss bug fixes and improvements. Pinning can also affect latency and cost for this route.
Help: You can unpin the route later from the route settings.
Buttons: [ Cancel ]   [ Pin model ]

anna: Qs: Is "Pin model" clear as a primary CTA? Is the latency/cost sentence too vague? Any a11y phrasing issues?

mike: Nice start. Two quick suggestions:
- "Pin model" is accurate but maybe a softer phrase for broader users: "Keep current model".
- Add a small inline cue for the cost line: "See estimated impact" that links to the cost estimator.

sree: Accessibility notes:
- Avoid language that sounds irreversible. "Pin" is okay if we immediately say unpin is possible.
- Include an aria description referencing Route settings where the user can undo.
- For screen readers, a short bulleted summary helps:
  • Prevents automatic model updates
  • May change latency and cost
  • Can be undone from Route settings

zoe: Engineering tradeoffs:
- We have per-route cost telemetry. If we expose an "Estimated impact" expand, call it out in the copy: "See estimated impact on latency and cost."
- Avoid parentheses; separate sentences read better in TTS.

design-bot: Linter reminders:
- Primary CTA <= 20 chars.
- Use sentence case for buttons and body.
- No trailing punctuation on CTAs.

anna: Revised copy after feedback — compact and a11y-focused:
Header: Keep current model
Body: Keep this route on the selected model version instead of applying automatic model updates. This improves output stability but you may miss fixes and improvements. See estimated impact on latency and cost.
Help: You can unpin this route later from Route settings.
Buttons: [ Cancel ]   [ Keep current model ]

anna: Tagging @mike @sree @zoe for final checks before I add the small expand control for the estimator.

mike: ✅ Short and clear, I like it.

sree: 👍 A11y ok. When you add the expand control, give it an accessible name and ensure expanded content is keyboard focusable.

zoe: Will wire the estimator. We'll show low/median/high ranges so the copy is backed by numbers.

anna: Thanks — I'll push this into the modal branch and include aria notes in the PR.
